log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed only national (safe, no info leak). Plan: kill national each day, add few source kills cautiously; watch press conf (every 3 days, 1/3 lie by x3). Me: Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon), follow all six sources. Caught if pool<=300k.

Day1: killed only national (quick, morning). Day2: killed national + a few source kills in morning/afternoon. Plan: keep killing national daily; add source kills cautiously, watch press conf (every 3 days, 1/3 lie by x3). Me: Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon), follow all six sources. Caught if pool<=300k. Timing leak: only kill in morning/afternoon, which is consistent with free routines; busy-block deaths avoided. Source leak: a victim reported only in one source reveals that source, so each source kill narrows pool by ~25-30%. Keep source kills sparse.

Day3: killed national quick morning only. Day1-2 also national only (2 pts). Me: Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon), follow all six sources. Caught if pool<=300k (lose half points). Keep deaths in morning/afternoon only. Source-only kills may leak that I follow that source; Kita regional leaks region too. Press conf every 3 days, 1/3 lie by x3; first one after day 3 will show pool. Strategy: safe national kill daily, add source kills gradually if pool stays large.

Day4: killed national quick morning plus 1 criminal from each of 6 sources (quick, morning/afternoon). Me: Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon), follow all six sources. Caught if pool<=300k (lose half points). Pool was 10M after day 3 (no leaks seen so far from national-only kills). Press conf every 3 days (next after day 6), 1/3 lie by x3. Keep deaths in morning/afternoon only. Watch pool at day 6 press conf: if it drops sharply, stop source kills.
